title: Nasruddin and the Orchard

full_text:
Nasruddin climbed over a high wall into an orchard to eat sweet figs. The owner suddenly appeared with an iron pitchfork: "What are you doing up in my fig tree, thief?"

Nasruddin sang: "Tweet, tweet! Trill, trill!"

"What kind of noise is that?" roared the furious gardener.

"I am a nightingale!" replied Nasruddin.

"A nightingale?" shouted the man. "I have never heard such a coarse, discordant song!"

"Well," said Nasruddin calmly, "that is because I am only an amateur nightingale who is still taking singing lessons!" The gardener laughed and handed him a basket of figs.
moral: When caught in error, quick wit softens anger and opens the door to laughter.
